text:
Evan: Heads-up: scheduling pen test next week. Need owners for RBAC, KMS key for evidence, audit export path, and retest window. Short checklist please.
Tara: I can take RBAC + automation. Plan: ephemeral role `pt-assessor-1805559001` with max session 4h, tag `pt-window=1805559001`.
Luca: KMS: provision dedicated key alias `alias/pt-evidence-1805559001` in staging account. Only grant to assessor role and ingestion svc. Revoke grant at window close.
Priya: Logs: export CloudTrail + app access logs to `s3://rw-pt-evidence/1805559001/`. Set lifecycle: raw 30d -> archive; parsed alerts mirrored to SIEM 90d.
Evan: presigned uploads? prefer 4h expiry and unique prefixes per assessor. Also require SHA256 checksum file alongside evidence.
Tara: automation snippet we'll hand to assessors: assume role policy; we'll generate role ARNs post-dry-run.
Luca: example KMS grant (ops-run):
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-1805559001 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-1805559001 --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "pt-assessor-grant-1805559001"
Priya: CloudTrail export path should include `audit/` and record assume-role events + grant ids. We'll add verification that the S3 objects have checksum metadata.
Evan: retest slots: Thu 14:00-15:00 and Fri 10:00-11:00. Can ops reserve both?
ops-bot: Calendar holds created: Thu 14:00-14:30, Thu 14:30-15:00, Fri 10:00-10:30, Fri 10:30-11:00. Linked to ticket RW-PT-2026-1805559001.
Tara: action items: I will push terraform module for role + presign endpoint integration. Will include test assume-role workflow.
Luca: I'll create KMS key + grant/revoke job (revoke at 6h post-window). Will post grant-id here.
Priya: I'll configure bucket lifecycle + SIEM mirror and add retention checklist to ticket.
Evan: create minimal runbook with escalation contacts and SLOs (30m for access issues). Dry-run Tue 07:00, live Tue 09:00.
ops-bot: Jira RW-PT-2026-1805559001 created and assigned to Tara, Luca, Priya.
Tara: thumbs up. Please ping this thread with PR link and grant IDs.
Luca: will do.
Evan: thanks all — we'll reconvene Mon EOD for final check.
